discover_companies.purpose: Turn the text you typed into company names and official careers URLs.
prompt: The user typed: "{input_text}"

List each company it names, fixing spelling (Nividia means NVIDIA). Use WebSearch and WebFetch to find each one's official careers page that lists jobs. If that page has a search parameter, add an intern search, like ?q=intern.

Fill "companies" in @data/tmp/discovery.json with one object per company: {"name": official short name, "careers_url": URL, "notes": one sentence on how you confirmed it}. If you can't find a company, set "careers_url" to null and say why in notes.
Don't edit any other file. Reply with one line: how many companies you found.

investigate_company.purpose: When automatic detection fails, find a supported method and params that read every job, or recommend a new method.
prompt: Find a way to scrape every job listing for {company}. This is attempt {attempt} of {max_attempts}.
Inputs:
- @data/tmp/investigation.json: the careers URL and earlier attempts with the validator's reasons. Don't repeat a failed proposal.
- @data/tmp/evidence.json: what automatic inspection found on the careers page.
- @data/methods.json: the only supported methods and their params.
Choose a method and params from methods.json. Prefer the company's job system API, which reports a total, over the browser methods. Investigate with WebFetch, WebSearch, and Bash.

Bash only allows .venv/Scripts/python, curl, grep, head, wc, sort, and uniq, run from the current folder. Don't use cd, mkdir, cat, or redirects. Write scratch scripts with the Write tool in data/tmp/scratch/, which already exists.
Jobs are later filtered to {allowed_countries}. With a browser method, add the site's own location filter for those countries to the URL when it has one.
Test by writing "proposal" in investigation.json, then running: .venv/Scripts/python scripts/test_method.py --investigation
It runs the real validator and prints the report. Adjust until the status is pass, or needs_approval when the site reports no total.
Final result in investigation.json:
- "proposal": {"method": NAME, "params": {...}}, your best tested proposal.
- "recommendation": only when no supported method can work: {"summary", "suggested_method", "how_it_works", "evidence"}, with "proposal" set to null.
- "notes": two sentences on what you found.

Only edit investigation.json. Scratch files may go in data/tmp/scratch/. Never change scripts/ or other data files. Don't bypass logins, CAPTCHAs, or bot protection. If the site blocks automated access, write a recommendation.
Reply with one word: pass, needs_approval, recommendation, or failed.
